_comment: Chocolate tablets category config. Shared corpus with chocolate_bars: both use the same BSIP0 raw (choc_bsip0_raw_20260621T093256.json, 146 records, Shufersal) and the same task391 BSIP1/BSIP2 runs (121 scored products: 92 tablets + 29 bars). subpool_filter selects the 'chocolate_tablet' subcategory as classified by classify_chocolate() in plausibility_gate.py — tablet markers (טבלת, טבלה, tablet brands like Milka/Lindt/Toblerone) plus default for non-countline products. run_id = fresh_rescore_task391_20260624_113405. Flags from flag_snapshot: BARI_GLASSBOX_W4=True, BARI_FIBER_FERMENT_V1=True, BARI_SHELF_RELATIVE_V1=True, BARI_FAT_TECH_V1=True; all others False. Live page displays 35/92 tablets — the 57 non-displayed are CORPUS_NOT_DISPLAYED in the diff (all E-grade products curated out by editorial curation). OFF check = PASS (all Shufersal direct scrape).

subpool_filter.source: fresh_rescore_task391_20260624_113405 manifest chocolate_tablet list; classify_chocolate() in plausibility_gate.py

scoring._source: fresh_rescore_task391.py (BSIP0 -> BSIP1 -> BSIP2 pipeline; 121 total scored; tablets=92)

exclusions.reason: missing_data_discard_rule: ingredients_raw scrape captured only an allergen-advisory fragment (כפי שרשום על גבי האריזה עלול להכיל אגוזי לוז, 45 chars), not the actual ingredient list. Nutrition panel is complete and verified, but the site's completeness bar requires BOTH verified nutrition AND a verifiable ingredient list. One-shot recovery not re-attempted since 2026-06-24 (missing_data_discard_rule: no re-sourcing investment).
